paragraphs.text: Zalgadib was a Tempest Efreet from Suq'Ata on Dominaria .

The efreet defended Ramses Overdark 's keep, and in exchange, he got to eat Ramses if he was still alive after the end of the efreet's service. It never came to that, because Ramses died 256 years before Zalgadib's contract to service to the keep ended. Zalgadib himself was killed by Kolo Meha , who had been sent by Tetsuo Umezawa to destroy Overdark's keep.
